title: I Love Ears
description: This Mod gives Everyone the Ability to have Deadmau5 Ears.
body:
This Mod Gives Everyone in the Whitelist the Deadmau5 Ears by using the Vanilla Code.

![Image showing how the Ears look in Game](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/btFpGfvm/images/c23958ca4c77e4d5179cde23eb26b8d6be85c26e.png)

The Ears can be enabled with the Whitelist in the Config File (Mod Menu is recommended to change the Config) for selected Players or entirely disabled.

The Ear Texture is inside the Skin Texture.

Here is a Template (from the Minecraft Wiki):

![The Ear Texture Template](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7437d712ed5a5591d6175687f442071f33304300.png)

Red is the Front of the Ears and Blue the Back.
The other Colors are the Sides of the Ears.
